senses.gloss: भिल् भिल् = rt. बिल्, q. v.

भिल्म भिल्म, अम्, n. a word used by
Yāska (Nirukta 1. 20) to explain बिल्म, q. v.

भिल्ल भिल्ल, अस्, m., N. of a wild mountain
race, probably the modern Bheels, (they live in the
Vindhya mountains, in the forests of Malwa, Mewar,
and Kandesh, and in the Dakhin to the north of
Poona; they were formerly notorious for their depre-
dations); a kind of the Bhillas; (ई), f. the plant
Symplocos Racemosa.
—भिल्ल-गवी, f. = गवयी,
the female of the Bos Gavæus.
—भिल्ल-तरु, उस्,
m. Symplocos Racemosa; [cf. भिल्ली.]
—भिल्ल-
भूषणा, f. the seed of the plant Abrus Preca-
torius.

भिल्लोट or भिल्लोटक, अस्, m., N. of a species
of plant, (perhaps) = भिल्ल-तरु.

भीलुक, अस्, आ, अम्, = भीरुक above; (अस्), m.
a bear; [cf. भल्लूक, भीरुक.]

भीलभूषणा भील-भूषणा. See भिल्ल-
भूषणा, p. 711, col. 1.
